status: editable DESIGN content; not rolled by any drop table yet. attunement.grant_legendary is the only way in.
notes: Each row is a legendary item whose power activates only when decanted into a Legendary attunement slot. Numbers are provisional DESIGN values, not certified balance. Every lattice row carries a tell (DM046_0 section 11).

legendaries.name: Prismatic Prism
legendaries.descriptor: a faceted violet lens that hums against the palm
legendaries.description: Weapon blows refract into arcane light before they land.

lattice.tell: The blow bends into a prism of violet light an inch from the skin.

legendaries.name: Voidborne Shroud
legendaries.descriptor: a scrap of cloth darker than the room around it
legendaries.description: Arcane and radiant force sinks into the shroud and does not come out.

lattice.tell: Light and spellfire vanish into the shroud without a sound.

legendaries.name: Unyielding Stance
legendaries.descriptor: an iron boot-plate stamped with a closed fist
legendaries.description: Stuns, paralysis, and disarms slide off a body that refuses them.

lattice.tell: The body locks, shudders, and simply does not yield.

legendaries.name: Aegis of First Light
legendaries.descriptor: a warm gold disc that brightens when threatened
legendaries.description: At the instant combat begins, a ward equal to half your health unfolds.

lattice.tell: A dome of first light unfolds before anyone draws steel.

legendaries.name: Royal Arrogance
legendaries.descriptor: a signet ring too heavy for its size
legendaries.description: Before initiative, a pulse of divine contempt strikes every foe. A DEX save halves it.

lattice.tell: A pressure of pure disdain rolls outward before the first breath.

legendaries.name: Herald's Haste
legendaries.description: The first round begins with the bearer already moving faster than the room.

lattice.tell: The bearer is already mid-step when everyone else starts to move.
